Uploading the initial artefacts for ClearBank — see attached stubs and short notes below. Full exports are on the drive link in the metadata.

Attachments (stubs referenced):
- release_authority_matrix_v1.xlsx (roles, approval thresholds, delegated on-call approvers)
- ci_pipeline_runbook.pdf (CI gate config, branch protection, required status checks)
- kms-key-rotation-snapshot.csv (rotation timestamps for KMS keys used in production)

Summary notes (short):
- Release authority: Production promotions require two approvers for high-risk services (defined in matrix). Team leads can auto-approve low-risk rollouts during a 24/7 maintenance window; all auto-approvals are recorded in the matrix with the delegating manager's sign-off.
- CI gates: We enforce branch protection + required GH Actions checks. Examples attached:
  * Success run: actions/runs/987654321 (artifact: build, test, integration smoke)
  * Blocked PR: actions/runs/987654987 (missing required security-scan status)
  * Flaky failure example retained with triage notes
- Secrets & rotation: Keys are managed in GCP KMS. Primary rotation cadence: monthly for data-plane keys, quarterly for long-lived signing keys. Service-account short-lived tokens are minted by our token broker with TTL = 15 minutes; CI ephemeral runner tokens are rotated per pipeline run. KMS rotation snapshot includes key IDs and rotation timestamps.
- Emergency changes: We maintain a change-exceptions Jira project (CHGEX). In the last 12 months there were 4 emergency hotfixes; each has a post-approval note and rollback plan referenced in the ticket (example: CHGEX-204).

Privacy/redaction: logs exported have PR titles redacted for customer privacy; we can provide full ticket IDs to the assessor under an NDA if required.

Next steps: Chloe — please confirm delivery is sufficient for Auditeq ingest or if they prefer alternate formats (zip of raw logs, signed attestation). I can also include a short attestation statement from Product Security if needed.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Principal Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
